question: Put these early milestones in Charles Taze Russell's spiritual search in chronological order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 5

items: 1869: Russell attends a meeting of Second Adventist preacher Jonas Wendell
1870: Russell forms a Bible study class with acquaintances in Pittsburgh and Allegheny
January 1876: Russell receives a copy of Herald of the Morning from Nelson Barbour
1877: Barbour and Russell jointly publish Three Worlds, and the Harvest of This World

question: Put these events in the founding of Russell's publishing work in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 5

items: 1877: Russell writes the pamphlet The Object and Manner of Our Lord's Return
1877: Barbour and Russell jointly publish Three Worlds, and the Harvest of This World
1878: Barbour denies the ransom doctrine, prompting Russell's break with him
July 1879: Russell begins publishing Zion's Watch Tower and Herald of Christ's Presence

question: Put these Watch Tower Society headquarters milestones in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 5

items: 1889: The Bible House is completed in Allegheny, Pennsylvania
1908: Society representatives are sent to Brooklyn to purchase property
1909: The Brooklyn headquarters residence is named Bethel
1918: Headquarters operations are temporarily moved back to Pittsburgh

question: Put these events of 1914 in the order they occurred.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapters 5-6

items: January 1914: The Photo-Drama of Creation premieres in New York City
June 28, 1914: Archduke Francis Ferdinand is assassinated
August 1914: Germany invades Belgium and France, and World War I begins
October 2, 1914: Russell declares that the Gentile Times have ended

question: Put these events surrounding Russell's death and succession in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 6

items: October 31, 1916: Charles Taze Russell dies at Pampa, Texas
January 6, 1917: Rutherford is elected president at the annual meeting
Summer 1917: The Finished Mystery is released and four opposing directors are removed
August 8, 1917: The ousted directors and their supporters leave the Bethel family

question: Put these events of the 1917-1918 internal controversy in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 6

items: July 17, 1917: The Finished Mystery is released and four opposing directors are removed
August 8, 1917: The disgruntled ex-directors leave the Bethel family
January 5, 1918: The annual meeting confirms support for Rutherford and his directors
March 26, 1918: The opposers hold their own separate Memorial celebration

question: Put these 1918 events of persecution and imprisonment in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 6

items: March 15, 1918: The tract Kingdom News Number 1 is released
May 7, 1918: Federal warrants are issued for Rutherford's arrest
June 21, 1918: Rutherford and his associates are sentenced to 20 years
August 26, 1918: Headquarters operations are transferred back to Pittsburgh

question: Put these events of Rutherford's release and its aftermath in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 7

items: March 25, 1919: The eight imprisoned brothers leave Atlanta for Brooklyn
March 26, 1919: The men are released on bail
May 4, 1919: Rutherford delivers a public lecture in Los Angeles
September 1, 1919: The Cedar Point, Ohio convention begins

question: Put these Kingdom-preaching methods in the order they were introduced.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 7

items: 1912: The Photo-Drama of Creation project begins
February 1922: Rutherford delivers his first radio broadcast, in California
February 1924: Radio station WBBR begins broadcasting
1934: Portable phonographs are introduced for house-to-house preaching

question: Put these early-career milestones of J. F. Rutherford in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 6, p. 67

items: Rutherford becomes an official court reporter at about age 20
May 5, 1892: Rutherford's license to practice law in Missouri is granted
Early 1894: Rutherford accepts three volumes of Millennial Dawn from colporteurs
1906: Rutherford is baptized

question: Put these events in the adoption of the name "Jehovah's witnesses" in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 7, p. 80

items: 1920s: Watch Tower articles increasingly stress believers' role as Jehovah's witnesses
1931: A convention is held in Columbus, Ohio
July 26, 1931: Rutherford reads the "Warning From Jehovah" resolution
Later that same day: Rutherford presents the "A New Name" resolution

question: Put these events in the development of the Jonadab teaching in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 7, p. 85

items: 1932: Jehonadab is identified as prefiguring a class with an earthly hope
August 15, 1934: A Watchtower article affirms that Jonadabs may be baptized
April 1, 1935: The Watchtower announces a convention for Jehovah's witnesses and Jonadabs
May 30, 1935: The Washington, D.C. convention begins

question: Put these newspaper and publicity milestones in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 5

items: December 1904: The Watch Tower announces that Russell's sermons are appearing in newspapers
1908: The Society decides to relocate to Brooklyn partly to expand newspaper reach
1912: The Photo-Drama of Creation project begins
By 1913: Russell's sermons reach an estimated 15,000,000 newspaper readers

question: Put these U.S. arrest totals of Witnesses in the order the years occurred.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 7, p. 85

items: 1933: U.S. arrests of Witnesses reach 268 for the year
1934: U.S. arrests of Witnesses reach 340 for the year
1935: U.S. arrests of Witnesses reach 478 for the year
1936: U.S. arrests of Witnesses reach 1,149 for the year

question: Put these events of the annual meeting held during Rutherford's imprisonment in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 7, p. 74

items: January 2, 1919: A convention begins in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
January 4, 1919: The annual meeting of the Watch Tower Society is held
A letter from the imprisoned Rutherford is read to the assembled audience
Rutherford is re-elected president of the Society
